{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out refunded orders for conversion rate (only completed orders count)
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_rates = completed_orders.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Find the segment with the highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_rates.idxmax()

# Print the conversion rates for inspection
print(conversion_rates)

# Return the best segment
best_segment"}
